race.comment: There's a few chances in this. PAFITIS (5) is going better than form suggests. Safely held out of grade two back then worked hard up front last time and swamped late over a little further. Back in trip and expected to take catching. MILK FOAM (11) was having first run for new yard with a fair sixth here fresh. Usually improves with racing under her belt and she still possesses some upside. Can build on the fresh effort with natural improvement. VATICAN ROSE (12) is another overdue. Tricky gate but will give a sight. ONE LAST PROMISE (8) was green and turned in a moderate debut but has upside and the blinkers added.
